about: Phase 11 hand review (26 Sep 2026): readable records that held overlapping slices of one printed passage. Each passage was read on its pages; the record that opens it is repaired to the whole passage ('replaces', taken between 'opening' and 'closing' by textbook_span.take_span), and the record that held a later slice is merged into it ('merges', noted with 'mergeNote'). Published by tool/literature/publish_reviewed_blocks.py, which writes back 'recordIds'.
